title: Nice idea, needs retrospective entry feature
content:
I'm traveling around Western Australia, (an area as big as Europe, or about a third of the USA mainland). However for most of it you get no Internet access...there is no phone coverage anywhere here. 
I'm disappointed that I can't fill in the substantial gaps this app doesn't fill. If I could just draw on the map all the roads I've been on, it would be about 10 times more accurate than what it is recording of my trip. 
Also, the fact that I've only just gotten this app but can't add all the places I've already been around the world, and which I'm not likely to revisit, is disappointing. 
I understand this app is set up to log locations to win challenges - I don't care about the challenges, I'm going to look for an app that does what yours does but allows me to add locations retrospectively.
author: crgwllms

title: Life enhancing!
content:
It might be very simple, and it mightn't really do much, but, any app that encourages you to get out of your phone rather than deeper into it is a good app in my opinion.

I've seen some awesome places I never would have if I wasn't trying to clear a different route.

I also find it a great graphical aid when explaining trips and routes to others. Many members of my extended family have this app now, and although we don't allow mobile phones at the dinner table, we do allow the comparing of cleared fog.

I have no issue with the fact that you can't clear locations from the past either, and in my opinion anyone who does is just a whiner. Enjoy it for what it is, and get out there and clear whatever you can manage. I used to be an interstate truck driver here in Australia, and I'd almost have the eastern states cleared if this app was around back then, but it wasn't, so I guess I'll just have to find the time to return or just get on with clearing where I travel from the present.

Five stars. :)

title: 6 years later and I still love this app!
content: I originally found this app when looking for something that would track my explorations through the world the same way I made and filled maps in Minecraft. I found Fog of World back then, and all these years later I’m still very happy with the app. It’s nice to be able to look back and see exactly where I’ve been, across the world. It’s been great also that the app has continued to be developed and improved! Just came here to update because I’ve been having persistent crashes, hoping that will be solved now. A nice feature would be if you could colour code the trails by time, either time recorded or time loaded into the app - that would be a very cool new dimension! Keep up the awesome work and thank you for a very awesome tracking app :)
author: rhobslein

title: Still Crashes
content:
Posted: 20-10-2019
Device: iPhone X
Title: Still Crashes
Rating: 2 Stars
App Version: 2.2.20

When the app actually works, it logs my trip. But unfortunately, I am constantly receiving notifications that the app isn’t working - when I open it, it crashes. The errors/crashes seem to occur with every second update but the app does work once in a while and often seems to have the same problem(s). I’ve been waiting since version 2.2.19, so usually... the next update (which may be: Version 2.2.21, or whatever developers choose/do) would usually fix the crash.

—————————
[15-OCT-2018]
- Constantly Crashes
- 1 Star Rating

Although this logs my recent trips and not the trips I made when I first downloaded the app many years ago, the app is constantly crashing. At first, it was hard enough trying to get the app to record my travels and would only show my house (giving many safety/security concerns - there was nothing stating otherwise when I first started using this app) but now it’s hard trying to get the app to work and stay open without errors crashing it. The last 2 updates haven’t fixed the problem.
